title: Customer Enablement Manager
status: Official employer-hosted posting available 2026-11-09; reconfirm before applying
source: Mural/Ashby employer listing checked 2026-11-09; candidate-created work sample
headline: Customer learning that accelerates time to value
thesis: Design a scaled customer learning system with evidence-linked onboarding, modular learning paths, scenario-based labs, adoption signals and targeted interventions for customers with low proficiency or delayed activation.
requirements: Execute self-guided live cohort-based and peer-led customer education
Build adaptive learning journeys by role, product use case and milestone
Produce courses guides videos templates and interactive simulations
Collaborate with Product Marketing and Customer Success on launches
Measure learner engagement proficiency and product adoption
Enable Customer Success colleagues using reusable materials
phases: Map primary customer personas, onboarding friction and existing content inventory
Role and use-case learning map, baseline adoption measurement plan
Build a small interactive education lab and reusable learning library
Modular sample academy, cohort session and success metrics dashboard
Run a measured enablement pilot and iterate based on adoption signals
Pilot retrospective, intervention playbook, 90-day customer education roadmap
